jobs.title: Developer
Stage Software Development
jobs.description:
Wil jij meebouwen aan de technologie én AI‑oplossingen voor Albert Heijn, Etos en Gall\&Gall? Binnen TechNL Labs werk je aan vernieuwende software en intelligente systemen die het doen van boodschappen nog makkelijker, leuker en sneller maken. Je krijgt de kans om hands‑on aan de slag te gaan met moderne technologieën en generatieve AI‑toepassingen om mogelijk jouw ideeën écht tot leven te brengen.


Belangrijke informatie over de stage:

* Bij Albert Heijn werken we hybride: dat betekent een combinatie tussen 2 dagen werken op ons hoofdkantoor in Zaandam en 3 dagen thuiswerken. Als team zijn we daar al aan gewend en hebben we goede oplossingen gevonden om een geweldige stage deels op afstand te hebben.
* De stage start vanaf februari 2027 voor een periode van 5 maanden.
* De stage is een meewerkstage en kan daarom niet gecombineerd worden met een afstudeerstage.
* Je werkt 40 uur per week, met binnen je werkweek ruimte voor je schoolopdracht.

**Jouw nieuwe baan en werkplek.**  

Als Stagiair Software Development bij TechNL Labs draai je volledig mee in een multidisciplinair innovatieteam. Samen met business developers, conceptontwikkelaars en UX‑designers werk je aan het bedenken, bouwen en testen van innovatieve concepten, variërend van nieuwe functionaliteiten in de omgeving van Albert Heijn tot prototypes die inspelen op de nieuwste technologische ontwikkelingen.


Tijdens jouw stage ga je onder andere aan de slag met:

* Het bedenken van nieuwe technische concepten die waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en interne collega’s.
* Het ontwikkelen van software in talen zoals Kotlin, Python en Typescript, en met frameworks zoals React/NextJS en Spring Boot.
* Het testen van innovaties volgens de build‑measure‑learn‑methodiek.
* Het live zetten van functionaliteiten binnen de AH‑omgeving.
* Het samenwerken met stakeholders uit marketing, communicatie en IT.


We vinden het belangrijk dat jij jezelf kunt zijn in een omgeving die openstaat voor verschillende perspectieven, een omgeving waarin we nieuwsgierig zijn en elkaar waarderen. Voor deze functie zoeken we bij voorkeur iemand die de diversiteit in ons team, in de breedste zin van het woord, versterkt. Iemand die vanuit eigen achtergrond en persoonlijke eigenschappen een ander geluid brengt en daarmee een goede aanvulling is op ons team.

**Dit bieden we jou.**

* Een interessante en veelzijdige stageplaats bij de innovatieafdeling van Albert Heijn, Etos en Gall\&Gall (TechNL Labs) voor 5 maanden.
* Een stage met veel verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid, waarbij je écht werkervaring opdoet en de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
* Een stagevergoeding van €500,\- per vier weken, aangevuld met een reiskostenvergoeding. Ook als je met je studenten\-OV gratis reist, ontvang je deze reiskostenvergoeding
* Een werklaptop (MacBook) die je tijdens je stage kunt gebruiken.
* De vrijheid om deels vanuit huis te werken.
* Een persoonlijke AH Bonuskaart met medewerkerskorting en een Premium abonnement met extra voordelen tijdens je stage.
* Gezellige borrels en (netwerk)events met alle stagiairs binnen Albert Heijn.
* Een inclusieve en informele werkomgeving waarin je je zowel persoonlijk als vakinhoudelijk kunt ontwikkelen.
* Een jong en begripvol team dat voor je klaar staat en met je meedenkt.

**Dit breng je mee.**  

Met onze 125\.000 collega’s vullen we elke avond ruim zeven miljoen borden. Misschien binnenkort samen met jou als onze nieuwe Stagiair Software Development! We zoeken iemand die:

* Een relevante HBO/WO‑opleiding volgt, bijvoorbeeld in Software Engineering, Informatica, AI of een vergelijkbare technische studie (minor AI is een pre).
* Affiniteit heeft met software‑ontwikkeling en moderne web‑ en backendtechnologieën.
* Nieuwsgierig is naar innovatie binnen retail tech.


Daarnaast ben je:

* Iemand die gestructureerd werkt, snel leert en scherp is op kwaliteit.
* Een echte probleemoplosser; jij denkt in kansen, test nieuwe ideeën en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen daadwerkelijk werken.
* Leergierig genoeg om nieuwe technologieën te omarmen en zelfstandig aan de slag te gaan, maar ook in staat om effectief samen te werken binnen het team.

**Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.**  

Albert Heijn vult met 125\.000 collega’s, verdeeld over ruim 1\.250 winkels in Nederland en Vlaanderen, negen home shop centers, zeven distributiecentra en ons hoofdkantoor elke avond ruim zeven miljoen borden. Bij Albert Heijn geloven we dat eten en drinken een essentiële rol speelt bij de grote uitdagingen in de maatschappij. Het levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan een gezonde levensstijl, het verbindt mensen en draagt bij aan een beter klimaat en daarmee een duurzame samenleving. Onze missie is dan ook: Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen. Albert Heijn Nederland is B Corp gecertificeerd. Deze certificering onderstreept onze missie waarmee het een bijdrage levert aan een gezonde, sociale en duurzame samenleving. De B Corp certificering wordt toegekend aan bedrijven die voldoen aan hoge normen voor sociale\- en milieuprestaties, transparantie en wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid.

**Ben jij er klaar voor om deze missie samen waar te maken?**  

Klik op de sollicitatiebutton om te solliciteren. Dat kan ook als je nét niet alle artikelen van ons boodschappenlijstje in huis hebt. Wil je liever eerst meer weten? Neem contact met ons op door te mailen naar stage@aholddelhaize.com en/of jensingmar.dikken@ah.nl. Zien wat TechNL Labs al heeft ontwikkeld? Kijk op https://labs.ah.nl/.

  

* ### **Solliciteren**


Stuur je sollicitatie in via deze website.

Als je aan het profiel voldoet nodigen we je snel uit voor een gesprek in de winkel.
* ### **Mogelijkheden**


Samen bekijken we de mogelijkheden voor jou in de winkel zoals de verschillende werktijden en welke plek het beste bij je past.
* ### **Welkom!**


Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan kun je snel beginnen! Welkom.

* Een leergierige houding
* Gezonde nieuwsgierigheid
* Sterke tech skills

jobs.title: Senior Semiconductor Process Engineer (InP)
jobs.description:
Job Introduction
**Who We Are**


IQE is a leading global supplier of compound semiconductor wafers and advanced materials. As one of the only compound semiconductor epitaxy foundries with worldwide presence and scalable manufacturing, IQE drives technology growth. Our vision is to be the top provider of advanced semiconductor materials by delivering exceptional quality, service, and innovation, making us the first choice for customers. Our strength comes from our diverse, expert workforce and a culture built on integrity, accountability, excellence, teamwork, and valuing people.


At IQE, we are committed to reaching Net Zero and creating a sustainable future. We actively strive to reduce our carbon footprint, invest in green initiatives, and embed sustainability into everything we do. Join us in driving meaningful change and making a lasting impact on the environment.

 **About the role**


The Senior InP Process Engineer is responsible for knowledge of Semiconductor process and product interactions with efficient and reliable operation of Semiconductor epitaxial reactors (MOCVD, MBE), ensuring high product quality, production yield, and equipment uptime. This role mainly supports both Production activities, including process development, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.  



  

Main Responsibilities.

* Support for the operation and performance of Semiconductor reactors (MOCVD, MBE) to meet product specifications and output targets.
* Assists in generating growth and process recipes for production and calibration activities aligned with customer specs and engineering guidelines.
* Adjust process parameters to ensure product meets specifications.
* Monitor critical reactor parameters and material outputs for consistency and quality.
* Monitor and chart reactor performance using statistical process control (SPC) methods in compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Interpret process metrics and reactor health parameters.
* Support corrective/preventive actions, problem solving, failure analysis, process qualification, and root cause investigations with supervision.
* Coordinates reactor scheduling activities to meet production targets efficiently.
* Ensure Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software is managed to control Process Engineering activities, and accurately record all works carried out for traceability.
* Supports the creation of technical reports that are shared internally and externally with clarity using supporting data.
* Analyse data from the suite of characterisation tools internally along with external results to guide process control.
* Use computerized tools and software to follow process and routine tasks, accurately recording all works carried out for traceability and within the scope of the role.
* Have basic experience and competence with troubleshooting
* Perform other functions and duties as required.

 **About you**

* Professional attitude.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* Computer Literacy: Experience using Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
* Has a commitment to product and process quality.
* Attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and consistency.
* Has technical analytical skills.
* Supports continuous improvement of the processes and practices of Process Engineering.
* Good problem\-solving skills with an analytical mindset and ability to use data\-driven methods to support issues resolution.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, effective in shift handovers and reporting.
* Good understanding and knowledge of Semiconductor reactors (MOCVD, MBE) or other semiconductor growth technologies.

  

Experience Requirements:

* Comprehensive experience in Process Engineering or equivalent manufacturing field.
* 5\+ Years experience in Process Engineering or equivalent combination of education, experience and/or knowledge is desirable.
* Reactor (MOCVD, MBE) process knowledge preferred.
* Experience with SPC and recipe editing is preferred.
* Experience and knowledge of InP

Experience with reactor maintenance is a plus.  
* 

  

Qualification Requirements:

* Degree in a STEM related discipline and or relevant experience
* Specialised technical qualifications relevant to the role.

 **Why should you join us?**


All our employees benefit from:

* Long Term Incentive Plans (LTIPs)
* Professional Development and career pathways
* Discretionary Bonus plans
* Attractive pension plans
* Income Protection \- Permanent Health Insurance (PHI)
* Long Service Awards 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 years
* Values\-based recognition awards
* Health Cash Plan includes discounts with high street brands
* Cycle to work plan (includes E\-bikes)
* Electric Car Scheme (salary dependent)
* Employee Assistance Programme (Free family, legal, financial and counselling support 24/7 Access to second medical opinion and unlimited access to a remote GP)
* Life assurance 4x salary
* Access to workplace Mental Health First Aiders/wellbeing rooms

  

IQE is an equal opportunities employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

  

Want to learn more? Contact the Talent Acquisition team at TalentAcquisitionTeam@iqep.com or visit our website Current Vacancies \| IQE Corporate (iqep.com)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are excited to announce a permanent opening for a **Senior Software Engineer** at our state\-of\-the\-art facility in Severn Beach, Bristol. This is an excellent opportunity to lead the design, development, delivery and continuous improvement of software solutions across the Oxford Instruments Plasma Technology product portfolio while remaining actively involved in hands\-on software development.

  

Provide technical leadership throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring software systems are robust, maintainable, secure and aligned with business objectives. Mentor engineers, drive engineering best practices and act as a key technical authority for customers and internal stakeholders.

  

**What You'll Be Doing**


* Leading the design and development of software for our products and systems.
* Taking ownership of complex software projects and technical challenges from concept through delivery.
* Developing high\-quality software using technologies including C\#, C\+\+ and C.
* Working closely with multidisciplinary teams across Engineering, Service, Product Management and Operations.
* Supporting customers and field service engineers in diagnosing and resolving challenging technical issues.
* Mentoring software engineers and helping establish best practices across the team.
* Reviewing software designs and implementations to ensure quality, maintainability and security.
* Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and the long\-term evolution of our software platforms.

  

**What We're Looking For**


We're interested in engineers who enjoy solving real\-world technical problems and can balance hands\-on development with technical leadership.

  

You'll likely have:


* Significant experience developing commercial software products.
* Strong C\#, C\+\+ and/or C development skills.
* Experience leading complex technical work and influencing technical direction.
* Experience working on Windows\-based applications and real\-time control systems.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across different disciplines.
* A degree in Computing, Physics or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

  

It would be advantageous if you also have experience in:


* Industrial automation or semiconductor equipment.
* Hardware interfacing and control systems.
* Cybersecurity and secure software development.
* AI/ML technologies or modern DevOps practices.

  

**Why Join Oxford Instruments?**

  

At Oxford Instruments Plasma Technology, we provide tools for engineering micro\- and nano\-structures, with customers using our process solutions to research and produce materials and semiconductors vital for everything from medical devices and diagnostics to electric cars and quantum computers.

  

You'll be joining a team that develops software for highly sophisticated scientific equipment used in research labs and advanced manufacturing facilities across the globe. This is an opportunity to work on technically challenging systems where software directly impacts the performance of world\-class hardware.

  

**Benefits include:**


* A competitive starting salary.
* Structured career development opportunities.
* Hybrid working setup (flexible mix of office and remote, project\-dependent).
* Private healthcare cover.
* Share incentive plan.
* 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays.
* Half\-days on Fridays.
* Defined contribution Group Personal Pension Plan.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability. jobs.description:
**What if you could shape a career as unique as you?**At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.
  

**A little more about your role…**Our Regulated Water Asset Design team serves the municipal water sector both in the UK and internationally. We hold long term framework agreements direct with water companies, including Severn Trent Water and Southwest Water. We also hold excellent relationships and trading agreements with blue chip contractors, including Costain and Galliford Try, for whom we deliver projects across the UK. We deliver a full range of design services across wastewater treatment, water treatment, sewerage and water network schemes.


To find out more about our Water business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at https://www.wsp.com/en\-us/sectors/wastewater


Due to a significant increase in the demand for our services, we are actively recruiting experienced Civil Engineers to help us service the AMP8 water industry capital investment programme. If you have relevant water industry design experience, we can offer you tailored experience to fulfil your career ambitions. Equally, if you are working in a different engineering sector, we can also offer mentoring programmes and training to support you in the transition to the water sector.


**Key Responsibilities**

As a Senior Civil Engineer you will have the opportunity to:


* Take ownership for all aspects of project delivery including health \& safety, technical, quality, schedule and budget
* Manage multi\-disciplinary teams
* Shape the delivery of our services and identify opportunities to deliver complimentary services from the wider WSP business in the UK and overseas
* Build relationships with our Clients to ensure that our services deliver project outcomes and customer satisfaction
* Contribute to the identification and delivery of innovative approaches, new services and digital products
* Contribute to the implementation of our Future Ready and Net Zero programme
* Act as an ambassador for best practice within the Asset Design team and on Client sponsored initiatives
* Undertake bid preparation, resource and budget development
* Line manage and support the professional development of graduate engineers and degree apprentices
* Contribute to recruitment and growth of the civil engineering team
Continue your career journey through the ongoing development of your technical, managerial and leadership skills  
* 

**What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…**

* A degree in Civil Engineering
* Chartered status, or significant progression towards membership of the ICE or CIWEM
* Experience in managing engineering design teams comprising civil engineers and other supporting disciplines
* Experience in delivery of projects to an identified budget and schedule
* Acted in a checking or technical approval role on linear civil engineering infrastructure projects, or industrial / process related design
* Experience in mentoring or coaching junior civil engineering staff to develop their technical skills and professional development
* Client\-facing experience
Good presentation, written, and verbal communication skills  
* 

**Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Or not quite the role you were looking for. Apply and we can see how your experience aligns to other roles we may have available.**

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the
best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
  

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.****\#LI\-ES1**
  
We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long\-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.


**Inclusivity \& Belonging**

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.


**Health \& Wellbeing**

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.


Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.


**Flex your time**

To enhance work\-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.


We also provide part\-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.


**Your development**

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*

### **Job summary**


We are currently looking for a **Senior Developer (SQ Web)** to join our **Technology and Service Operations** Function within the **Digital and Technology Group**.


This is a **full\-time** opportunity, on a **permanent** basis. The role will be based in 7/8 Wellington Place, Leeds, LS1 4AP.


Government departments and agencies are working towards implementing a minimum 60% attendance in office sites.

  

We are currently implementing a flexible, hybrid way of working, with a minimum of 8 days per month working on site to enable the collaboration and contact with partners and stakeholders needed to deliver MHRA business. Attendance on site is driven by business needs so depending on the nature of the role, this can flex up to 12 days a month, with the remainder of time worked either remotely or in the office. Some roles will need to be on site more regularly. Remote working is potentially available for some specific roles. Please discuss this with the recruiting manager before accepting an appointment.

  

### **Job description**

**Who are we?**


The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.


The MHRA Digital and Technology Group (DTG) exists to help protect and improve public health by enabling the Agency to become a modern, intelligence\-led regulator.


We bring together digital, data, technology, cyber security and artificial intelligence expertise to deliver services, platforms and insights that support the regulation of medicines, medical devices and healthcare technologies across the UK.


Our work goes beyond traditional IT. We design and deliver user\-centred services, harness trusted data, apply advanced analytics and responsible AI, and build secure, resilient digital foundations that help the MHRA make better decisions, work more effectively and respond to a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape.


By joining DTG, you'll help shape the future of regulation while delivering technology that makes a real difference to public health.


The Technology \& Service Operations (TSO) function is responsible for managing the existing IT infrastructure including both software and hardware, databases, and other technology platforms; leading the support and maintenance of applications; development and testing of new applications and platforms; and cyber and information security for the Agency.


The Engineering team, made up of software developers, DevOps engineers, Quality Assurance testers, and data professionals (including engineers, scientists, and visualization experts), is tasked with the creation of applications and services, ensuring quality for both new and existing agency offerings, and developing data visualizations through their expertise in data engineering and science.

### **Person specification**

**Role Purpose**


This Senior Developer role implements web applications and guides the ways in which the team works and provide technical leadership, to deliver cloud native web\-based solutions to our end users. The post holder will be proficient in a wide range of technical systems and be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written and will contribute to the developer community and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice.


The post holder will work in cross\-functional product squads on the design and development of creating cloud native (Azure), JavaScript based microservices (node.js) and front end (react) utilising agile (SAFe), paired programming, TDD and DevOps.

 **Key responsibilities and results areas**

* As an experienced voice in the technical team, you will steer implementation and code design decisions for contingent labour and service providers
* Mentoring more junior members of your team to develop and maintain high\-performance, scalable solutions
* Assist in leading the design and development of site/software projects following best practices, as well as regular status reporting
* Assist in leading in optimising, debugging, and enhancing existing software whilst preventing regression in live systems
* You must have solid JavaScript coding skills, experience of TDD/BDD (jest, enzyme, cucumber, gherkin), be collaborative (Jira, Confluence, GitHub)
